Name: bump-major
Summary: Increments the major component and resets minor and patch to zero, removing pre-release and build metadata.

Name: bump-minor
Summary: Increments the minor component and resets patch to zero, removing pre-release and build metadata.

Name: bump-patch
Summary: Increments the patch component, removing pre-release and build metadata.

Name: pre-release
Summary: Returns pre-release text without the leading hyphen, or empty text when absent.

Name: build-metadata
Summary: Returns build metadata without the leading plus sign, or empty text when absent.

Name: compare-semver
Summary: Compares semantic-version precedence, ignoring build metadata.

Parameters.Name: right
Parameters.Summary: The semantic version compared with the pipeline input.

Evaluation.Summary: Evaluated once in the context enclosing this compare-semver call.

Name: coerce-semver
Summary: Attempts to convert text or an existing semantic version to a semantic version, returning null for invalid input.

Name: semver-to-text
Summary: Returns canonical semantic-version text including pre-release and build metadata.
